notes:
Benchmarks UDP loopback on the board: udp_send to 127.0.0.1, udp_receive on the same port, one line per second printed by the report debug: tx/s rx/s totals lost and RTT avg/min/max in ms.

Read: the send timer is 11 ms (~90 pkt/s) because udp_receive's source loop yields every 10 ms, so ~100 pkt/s is the receive ceiling. Below that rate, lost = sent - received and rtt are the stack's own numbers. Push the send timer faster and rx/s flattens near 100: what grows is the lost count, which is the node limit, not the board's. Change the payload size by editing the 'x' padding in the send function (~50 bytes now); change the offered rate by editing the send timer's intervalMs (floor ~11 to stay under the ceiling).

Loopback caveat (test-flows/network-packages-pass.md): some WiFi stacks do not loop 127.0.0.1 back. If rx/s is 0 while tx/s is right, set host to the board's own LAN IP (from the wifi_status debug line with full message on) or to the host PC's IP and listen there: nc -u -l 9918. WiFi credentials: the flow's one config uses credentialName 'home' - create it in the editor first. Checked with thingstudio-compile --board board:lolin-s2-mini. First board run 2026-11-14: ~18 pkt/s, tx=rx within 1-2 (in flight), late=0, rtt avg ~56 ms (min 51). The path self-clocked - cycle time matched rtt, so the send waited on the stack (udp_send's 10 ms EAGAIN retry is the only sleep in its path) until the receive poll drained the loopback queue; the ~100/s node ceiling never bound.

import time
seq = context.get('seq', 0) + 1
context.set('seq', seq)
flow.set('tx', flow.get('tx', 0) + 1)
msg['payload'] = '%d:%d:%s' % (seq, time.ticks_ms(), 'x' * 32)
msg['topic'] = 'bench'
return msg

import time
p = msg['payload']
if isinstance(p, (bytes, bytearray)):
    p = p.decode()
parts = p.split(':')
seq = int(parts[0])
rtt = time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), int(parts[1]))
flow.set('rx', flow.get('rx', 0) + 1)
flow.set('rtt_sum', flow.get('rtt_sum', 0) + rtt)
mn = flow.get('rtt_min')
if mn is None or rtt < mn:
    flow.set('rtt_min', rtt)
mx = flow.get('rtt_max')
if mx is None or rtt > mx:
    flow.set('rtt_max', rtt)
last = flow.get('last_seq', 0)
if seq <= last:
    flow.set('late', flow.get('late', 0) + 1)
flow.set('last_seq', max(seq, last))
return None

tx = flow.get('tx', 0)
rx = flow.get('rx', 0)
dtx = tx - flow.get('tx_prev', 0)
drx = rx - flow.get('rx_prev', 0)
flow.set('tx_prev', tx)
flow.set('rx_prev', rx)
s = flow.get('rtt_sum', 0)
mn = flow.get('rtt_min')
mx = flow.get('rtt_max')
flow.set('rtt_sum', 0)
flow.set('rtt_min', None)
flow.set('rtt_max', None)
if drx > 0:
    lat = 'rtt avg=%dms min=%dms max=%dms' % (s / drx, mn, mx)
else:
    lat = 'rtt n/a (nothing received)'
lost = tx - rx
if lost < 0:
    lost = 0
msg['payload'] = 'udp loopback tx=%d/s rx=%d/s total tx=%d rx=%d lost=%d late=%d %s' % (dtx, drx, tx, rx, lost, flow.get('late', 0), lat)
msg['topic'] = 'bench'
return msg
